name: okumoney-evm-contracts
description: OkuMoney EVM smart contracts - Yield-bearing stablecoin
author: OkuMoney

scripts.clean: hardhat clean && forge clean && rm -rf cache_hardhat typechain-types
scripts.test:flow: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/interactions/test-flow.ts --network localhost
scripts.test:flow:live: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/interactions/test-flow.ts --network sepolia
scripts.bridge:state: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/bridge/check-bridge-state.ts --network localhost
scripts.bridge:state:live: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/bridge/check-bridge-state.ts --network sepolia
scripts.bridge:burn: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/bridge/bridge-burn-to-solana.ts --network localhost
scripts.bridge:burn:live: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/bridge/bridge-burn-to-solana.ts --network sepolia
scripts.bridge:mint: NETWORK=sepolia npx hardhat run scripts/bridge/bridge-mint-from-solana.ts --network localhost
